mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops by more than 10% in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS shows a sustained 3-month decline and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals strengthening demand and labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases by more than 2% QoQ and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
